(kha)༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'don thabs gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'don thabs gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag la gsum/ gsang sngags su gdon pa dang*/ bdag med pa'i ngang las gdon pa dang*/ che ba'i yon tan du gdon pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ 'jam dpal gyi rnal 'byor gyis gdon pa dang*/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis gdon pa'o// dang po ni sems bskyed pa dang*/ skabs su 'gro ba sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po na ral gri dang*/ gnyis pa na mda'/ g.yon dang po na pusti dang*/ gnyis pa na gzhu 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ pad+ma'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa bsgoms pa'i thugs kar a bsam/ tshig thams cad a las skyes shing mi dmigs par bsam la gdon/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs// zhes pa'i gdams ngag go /yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'don na/ khro bo yin na snying gar nyi ma'i steng du a bsam/ zhi ba yin na zla ba'i steng du bsam/ tshig thams cad a las skyes shing mi dmigs par bsams la gdon/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che// rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od// ces pa'i gdams ngag go /bdag med pa'i ngang du 'don na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu sgra brnyan dang brag cha lta bur shes par byas la gdon to// stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste// zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs pa// zhes pa'i gdams ngag go /che ba'i yon tan du 'don na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsam/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos dang*/

rang sangs rgyas dang*/ tshangs pa dang dbang phyug 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin par bsams la gdon to// 'jog pa'i dus su mchod pa byas la rang bzhin med par gshegs su gsol/ thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces pa'i gdams ngag go /mdo bton pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ thun mong ba che ba'i yon tan du dmigs la gdon par bya'o// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// ༈ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgyud kyi bklag thabs ye shes grub ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dz+nyā na kā yā ya/ 'dir 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag la rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa las/ zab mo'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mi nus pa'i las dang po pa'am/ rnal 'byor zab mo la 'jug pas kyang thun mtshams rnams su che ba'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i tshul gyis gdon par 'dod pas dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid la byas te/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// gzhan don rdzogs byang thob bya'i phyir// zab mo'i rgyud sde bklag par bgyi// lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ rang mdun nam mkhar yid 'phrog pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus// pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis// rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sku mdog gser gyi lhun po ni// mtshams sprin gsar pas 'khyud bzhin mdzes// zhi 'dzum brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i dpal// ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis// shes rab ral gri glegs bam dang*// 'og mas thabs shes mda' gzhu bsnams// zla ba'i rgyab yol la brten nas// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// sna tshogs dar gyi sham thabs dang*// rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan// zur phud ut+pal la gnas pa'i// mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag por bcas// mkha' lam dbang po'i gzhu lta bu// snang stong zung 'jug ye shes sku// mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur// e ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal tshangs dbang sogs// srid zhi'i nyams 'gyur ji snyed kun// 'jam pa'i dpal las gzhan phan phyir// mtha' yas shes bya'i rjes song ba'i// mtshan dang sku yi bkod pa dang*// yon tan mkha' dang snyoms 'jug par// mi phyed mchog tu gus pa'i blos// ngag gi nor bu'i tam+bu ra// ye shes lus can 'jam dpal gyi// rdo rje'i mtshan don yang dag par// brjod pa'i gdangs su 'phos pa yis// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rgyud bskul bas// thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag yas pa// sa gsum khyab par rab tu 'phros// bdag dang yid can thams cad kyi// thog med nas bsags sdig ltung dang*// sgrib gnyis mun pa kun bsal nas// ji lta ji snyed shes bya la// blo mchog pad+mo rgyas par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la mos gus rtse gcig pas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa lan gsum sogs ci nus su 'don/

spro na/ oṃ sarba dharmā bha ba sogs kyi sngags ci rigs par bzla zhing phan yon kyang 'don par gsungs/ gang ltar yang mthar/ dngos dang yid las byung ba yi// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos// srid pa mthar byas de srid du// 'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyes gyur cig /oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes phung po gcig bsdus pa// srid zhi kun gyi dpal gyur pa'i// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po khyod kyi rdo rje'i mtshan// yang dag brjod pas rab bsngags bdag /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// dgyes bzhin rjes su bzung bar mdzod// gnas skabs tshul gnas thos bsam dang*// sgom pa'i blo gros rab rgyas shing*// 'chad rtsod rtsom la mtshungs med pa'i// smra ba'i nyi mar byin gyis rlobs// mthar thug shes dang shes bya kun// mi phyed ye shes sku thob nas// 'gro rnams 'jam dpal gzhon nu yi// go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ gzod nas spros bral 'jam pa'i dpal// rten 'byung sgyu ma'i ngang tshul gyis// snang char shar ba'i ye shes pa// rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings su gshegs// 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// des ni skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// yang mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor gzhol bas 'jam dpal gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'don na/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid ni// pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis// zhes pa nas/ mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur// ces pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// skye med don mtshon a dkar po// de las rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyud// rten 'byung sgra brnyan lta bu'i tshul// skyes tsam nyid nas skye 'gags sogs// spros pa'i mtshan ma ma dmigs pa// zab gsal gnyis med ye shes sku// rjes su dran pa'i ngang nas bklag

/ces gsal btab nas rgyud ci nus su 'don mthar/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// zhes sogs bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /yang na yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'don pa ni/ rang gi rgyun gyi yi dam gang la yang sbyar du rung bas/ de'i bdag bskyed gsal btab pa'i rjes/ khro bo yin na/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*// zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs dmigs pa sogs sngar bzhin no// yang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor gzhol bas bdag med pa'i ngang nas 'don pa ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgra brnyan dang brag ca lta bur shes par byas la ma yengs pa'i ngang nas 'don cing dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// de thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'don na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ thog mar 'jam dpal gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'don pa'i skabs ltar bdag nyid lhar gsal gdab/ de nas mdun du lha gsal gdab pa sogs che ba'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i tshul gyis rgyud 'don pa la 'jug de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du lus 'ja' tshon/ ngag brag ca/ sems spros bral nam mkha' lta bu shes par bya/ mthar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa sogs sbyar ro// 'di rnams kyi khungs ni rje btsun rin po ches rgyud kyi lung sbyor mdzad pa ltar dang*/ der ma zad 'khor lo bzhi pa'i rjes su bsngags pa las/ mtshan gyi don phan tshun re re zhing yang 'jam dpal ye shes kyi sku mngon du byas te/ rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis

bdag nyid lhar sgom par byed pa dang*/ che ba'i yon tan la lhag par mos pa dang*/ de kho na bdag med pa'i/ nyid yid la byed pa dag gis zhes gsungs pas kyang rim bzhin du bstan par bzhed do// de ltar dus gsum du brtson pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ spobs pa sgrub pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing bsgrub pa dang*/ tshe rabs kun tu mi khom par mi skye zhing 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ba dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis 'byor par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzungs dang*/ blo gros dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan mtha' yas pa dang ldan cing mi nyams pa dang*/ gong nas gong du 'phel ba la brten nas myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par 'gyur bas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul rgya cher phan yon gyi rjes su bsngags pa'i skabs rnams las 'byung ba ltar shes par byas nas blo ldan rnams kyis 'di kho na la gcig tu brtson par bya'o// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan la nye bar mkho ba'i phyir mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab la gzhi byas/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung sgros zin bris sogs las kyang cung zad bsnan te shin du gsal bar bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
